outcome_evidence: In base_image, the robot separates the initially nested cups (frames 500–800), builds a standing three-cup arrangement (frames 1048–1051), then gathers and nests them together (frames 1300–1700). Frames 1748–1813 show the compact cup stack resting unsupported and stable with both grippers clear. “Pack” is interpreted as nesting the cups together, since no separate packing container is visible. No failed acquisition, dropped cup, harmful side effect, or sustained unproductive behavior is established.
